text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
To think I couldn't even make the board...
The road of the Twinkle Series really is steep, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I...
need to get much, much stronger!
choice_data_list: I can't afford to stop now.
I can't afford to stop now, you know.

text_block_list.text:
To live up to your expectations, Trainer,
and those of everyone cheering for meâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking firmly ahead precisely when faced with defeat—
I was reminded once again of her strength.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
No matter how many times I lose, I won't get discouraged!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to keep running
so I can become someone like Dad—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's frustrating that I lost, but...
I'll use that frustration as a springboard to keep moving forward!
choice_data_list: When we get back, it's extra training!
It's extra training when we get back, okay!
